cases.name: accept_resting_buy
cases.pass: broker accepts the non-marketable limit and the engine ledger records it submitted with a broker id and an open status

cases.name: cancel_resting
cases.pass: engine ledger records canceled with zero fill and a fresh broker snapshot shows the order canceled

cases.name: cancel_again
cases.pass: second engine cancel of the already-canceled order sends the broker DELETE, raises nothing, adds no transport freeze reason, gets an answer the engine treats as data (204, 404 or 422; Alpaca documents 422 'The order status is not cancelable' at https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/reference/deleteorderbyorderid-1.md) and leaves the ledger intent, fills and positions unchanged; the answer is recorded, not assumed; without a DELETE the evidence class is engine_short_circuit

cases.name: definitive_rejection
cases.pass: a sub-penny limit reaches the broker (the harness FaultLedger exempts only this client id from the pre-send invalid_price_increment refusal), Alpaca refuses it with its documented minimum-price-variance 422 (body code 42210000, 'sub-penny increment does not fulfill minimum pricing criteria', https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/orders-at-alpaca.md) or a definitive 401/403/404, the client-id lookup returns 404, and the engine ledger records broker_refused (for 422 with refusal sub_penny_minimum_price_variance) with no position or cash effect; any other 400/422/429/5xx stays ambiguous and fails; unobserved when the engine refuses or rounds before any request reaches the broker

stop_rule: stop after the first failed or errored case; never retry a write
cleanup: cancel every non-terminal ledger intent carrying this run's client-id prefix on the same started transport, then prove flat and zero open orders with runner.reconcile over a fresh transport snapshot; otherwise write CLEANUP_REQUIRED
pass_status: native_faults_passed requires every case passed with native_paper evidence and a proven flat cleanup
